title: OpCall
description: Candidate single EditCommand envelope (SDK executable name: EditCommand). D RUNNER emits canonical OpCalls in Plan.calls and journal calls. Handler ids remain open. This increment is not a schema freeze.

scopedId.description: Current ScopedId vocabulary: parent, shot, or occurrence clip/track ids, plus cut ids.

anchorIdentity.description: Current resolved anchor identities, including scoped entity ids and the documented word, beat, and cut anchors.

op.description: Qualified operation id, e.g. timeline.opacity or myteam.stagger.

select.description: Authoring selector; executed calls use the canonical stable selector resolved by the runner. null for timeline-level operations.

args.description: Opaque finite JSON operation arguments in authoring units. Omitted keys, JSON null, explicit clip.clear keys, and ordinary objects (including {$absent:true} or {op:clear}) remain distinct. Only the selected handler interprets these values.

expect.description: Optional prior values keyed by direct-write path. Absence and present JSON values are tagged separately; command-specific requirements remain producer/consumer rules.

bindings.description: Runner-resolved anchor identity keyed by the exact authored TimeRef text.

created.description: Scoped IDs allocated by the runner for this call.

authorship.description: Per-write-path authorship classification; it carries no actor or authentication claim.

version.description: The tool version when it ran (filled by the runner).

resolved.description: Runner-populated IDs of the selected targets in the current ScopedId vocabulary.
